description: This file defines a UI component 'NotesList' using LightningJS framework. It renders a list of note items with search and add functionality, handling display logic and user interactions.

methods.name: _renderList
methods.description: Renders the list of notes or a message if no notes are available.

methods.name: $onSearch
methods.description: Emits a search event with the search query.

methods.name: $onAdd
methods.description: Emits an add event to create a new note.
